unverified_summary: Every row here is community documented rather than publisher confirmed. No developer channel publishes a roster, an income table or a spawn table, so no row qualifies as confirmed and every live row displays as Unverified. Income figures are the base rate before mutations and traits, which stack and can multiply a figure many times over. The Brainrot God and Secret tiers are recorded in part rather than in full, because those tiers are far larger than any published figure agrees on. Rows marked Removed are entries whose acquisition route has been retired or superseded; players who already hold them keep them.

fakes.claim: Somebody can add Spyder Elephant to your in game index for you
fakes.why_wrong: It is not in the index at all, and it cannot be traded or stolen unless the Spyder Chain item itself changes hands. Every offer of this kind is a scam.
fakes.origin: Trading and reselling servers, repeated by resale listings.

fakes.claim: Smurf Cat is an obtainable OG brainrot
fakes.why_wrong: It appears only on unreleased and speculated lists, sourced from teases rather than any release. No route to it exists.
fakes.origin: Tier list videos and speculation threads.

fakes.claim: A fixed roster total that never moves
fakes.why_wrong: Published totals range from 150 to over 525 and none of them comes from a publisher channel. The roster changes on the weekly update cycle.
fakes.origin: Aggregator guides copying each other without rechecking.
